themes_detail.label: Street Condition Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 77 THIS WEEK, up 651% from the 10.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 10.73), suggesting a sudden deterioration in road quality or a coordinated reporting event requiring immediate investigation.
evidence: 77 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 10.2 weekly average (651% spike, z-score 10.73)
Largest single-week deviation in the dataset, indicating acute infrastructure problem
Community board has repeatedly requested sewer inspection and repair (DEP), suggesting underlying infrastructure vulnerability
reporting_angles: What triggered the sudden spike in street complaints — pothole epidemic, flooding, resurfacing work?
Interview residents and DSNY/DOT about causes and timeline for repairs

themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Surge
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints exploded to 8 LAST WEEK, up 1500% from 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 15.0, highest severity spike in dataset), indicating either a sudden increase in illegal vending or a new enforcement crackdown.
evidence: 8 vendor enforcement complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (1500% spike, z-score 15.0)
Highest statistical severity score of all identified spikes
Community board requests support for merchant organizing, suggesting ongoing vendor-related tensions
reporting_angles: Is NYPD or Department of Consumer Affairs conducting a new enforcement operation in Highbridge/Concourse?
What is the nature of complaints — unlicensed food carts, sidewalk obstruction, safety violations?

themes_detail.label: Noisy Streets Escalating
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from streets and sidewalks surged to 89 LAST WEEK, up 269% from 24.1 weekly average (z-score: 4.16), while vehicle noise hit 20 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO (214% spike from 6.4 avg), indicating a multi-source noise problem accelerating across the district.
evidence: Noise - Street/Sidewalk: 89 complaints last week vs. 24.1 weekly average (269% spike, z-score 4.16)
Noise - Vehicle: 20 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 6.4 weekly average (214% spike, z-score 4.61)
Residential noise (2,404 total complaints over 90 days) remains among top 311 categories, suggesting chronic problem
reporting_angles: What construction, street events, or vehicle activity is driving noise complaints — are permits being monitored?
Canvass residents in noisiest blocks to identify sources and gather on-the-ground reporting

themes_detail.label: Building Maintenance Failures
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints hit 9 TWO WEEKS AGO (800% spike from 1.0 weekly average, z-score 11.31), while broader maintenance/facility complaints peaked at 39 THREE WEEKS AGO (976% spike from 3.6 avg), suggesting widespread building system deterioration affecting habitability.
evidence: Elevator complaints: 9 two weeks ago vs. 1.0 weekly average (800% spike, z-score 11.31)
Maintenance/Facility complaints: 39 three weeks ago vs. 3.6 weekly average (976% spike, z-score 13.39)
Heat/Hot Water remains top complaint category with 9,145 complaints over 90 days, indicating seasonal crisis that may have triggered cascading maintenance failures
reporting_angles: Are landlords failing to maintain building systems during winter months? Interview housing advocates and HPD.
Identify buildings with repeat elevator and maintenance complaints; profile tenant conditions and code violations

themes_detail.label: Sewage System Stress
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints spiked to 8 LAST WEEK, up 392% from 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 6.43), coinciding with community board's standing request to inspect and repair sewer lines on specific street segments, suggesting infrastructure vulnerability during high-demand periods.
evidence: 8 sewer complaints last week vs. 1.6 weekly average (392% spike, z-score 6.43)
Community board has annually requested DEP sewer inspection/repair on specific street segments, indicating known problem areas
Plumbing complaints (1,205 total over 90 days) and water leaks (709) suggest system-wide drainage or water pressure issues
reporting_angles: Which street segments have DEP sewer issues flagged — are repairs stalled or deferred?
Interview DEP about aging sewer infrastructure in Highbridge/Concourse and timeline for remediation
